# LLVM libc shared conversion support

Selected transitive headers from LLVM Project llvmorg-22.1.8, used by libc++
from_chars<float/double>. Source: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/llvmorg-22.1.8/libc
Files are unmodified; SOURCE_SHA256SUMS pins their contents. LICENSE.TXT applies.
This is header support only, not a host libc dependency or a full LLVM libc installation.
